commentary.bulkers: Chinese owners have committed their Capesize "Xin Jin Hai" 180/2009 Dalian, China (SS/DD 11/2024, BWTS fitted) to undisclosed buyers for USD 23 mill. Remind you that back in December, the sister vessel "Amity" 180/2009 Dalian, China (SS/DD 07/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold at USD 19,2 mill. The Panamax "ES Sakura" 76/2007 Imabari, Japan (SS 08/2027, DD 11/2025, BWTS fitted) of Erasmus Corp was sold for USD 14,5 mill. For reference, the two-years-older "Ocean Domina" 76/2005 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 06/2025, DD 08/2023) was sold back in January for mid USD 10 mill. Furthermore, the Chinese built "Magic Rainbow" 73/2007 Jiangnan, China (SS 12/2025, DD 06/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold for USD 12,6 mill. Mid-Atlantic Bulk Carriers have sold their Ultramax "Soho Principal" 63/2016 Yangzhou, China (SS 04/2026, DD 03/2024, BWTS fitted) for USD 26,5 mill. Note that back in January, the one-year-older "Steel Grace" 63/2015 New Times, China (SS 11/2025, DD 06/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold at USD 24,5 mill. On the Handysize sector, MW Shipping committed their "Schelde Confidence" 38/2011 Imabari, Japan (SS 01/2026, DD 01/2024, BWTS fitted) to Greek buyers Arion Shipping for USD 17,2 mill. Remind you that a week ago, the "Octbreeze Island" 38/2011 Shimanami, Japan (SS 10/2026, DD 08/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold at low-mid USD 15 mill.
commentary.tankers: Aeolos Management have sold their VLCC "Kassos I" 319/2007 Hyundai Samho, Korea (SS 07/2027, DD 07/2025, BWTS & Scrubber fitted) to UAE based buyers for USD 60 mill. Moreover, Thenamaris Ships Management sold the two-years-older "Athina II" 318/2005 Hyundai, Korea (SS/DD 12/2023, Scrubber fitted) for USD 56 mill, whilst the Japanese built "Yufusan" 311/2005 Mitsui, Japan (SS 10/2025, DD 12/2023, BWTS fitted) from Mitsui OSK Lines was sold to Chinese buyers for USD 52 mill. The MR2 "Neutron Ray" 50/2005 Shina, Korea (SS/DD 03/2025, BWTS fitted) of Interorient Marine Services was committed for USD 18,1 mill. For comparison, the one-year-younger "Spruce Express" 51/2006 Stx, Korea (SS 09/2026, DD 01/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold a couple of weeks ago at high USD 18 mill. In addition, the Japanese built "Evian" 48/2006 Iwagi, Japan (SS 07/2026, DD 04/2025, BWTS fitted) was sold to Middle Eastern buyers for USD 18,5 mill. Viken Shipping have committed their MR1 sister vessels "Inviken" & "Utviken" 37/2009 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS/DD 03/2024 both) to European buyers for USD 20 mill each, while the two-years-younger "Atria" 37/2011 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 07/2026, DD 08/2024) was sold for USD 23 mill.
